act_name: West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses (Repeal)Act, 2019
heading: Short title, and commencement
title: Short title, and commencement
text:
1.
Short title, and commencement. — (1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses (Repeal) Act, 2019.
(2) It shall come into force at once in its applicability to the extent of Islamabad Capital Territory.
